title: Heat-Proof Your Freight: Summer Shipping Tips for Sensitive Goods
summary: Keep sensitive shipments safe this summer with Universal’s smart shipping, packaging, and tracking tips. Ship with confidence, no matter how hot it gets.
body_markdown: Summer is peak season for high temperatures, tight capacity, and added risks, especially when you’re shipping goods that can’t handle the heat. At Universal Logistics Services, we know what it takes to protect sensitive freight, no matter how high the mercury climbs. Here’s how you can plan ahead and keep your shipments safe and on time all summer long.
